rules.name: Price tolerance
rules.condition: Invoice unit price differs from PO price by no more than 2% or INR 5,000 per invoice, whichever is lower
rules.action: Invoice may be posted; larger differences are resolved by the buyer before posting

sources.excerpt: by no more than 2% or INR 5,000 per invoice, whichever is lower

openQuestions.question: How long does a non-PO invoice take to handle?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Needed to size the benefit for the 20% of invoices without a PO.

openQuestions.question: What share of invoices arrives on paper? The estimate is 10 to 15% and has not been counted.
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Decides whether paper capture is worth designing for.

openQuestions.question: Is API_MATERIAL_DOCUMENT_SRV exposed outside SAP, and can AP read goods receipts through it?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Determines whether GR checks can run without SAP GUI.

openQuestions.question: Will the supplier invoice API be activated and exposed, and when?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: API-first posting depends on it; GUI scripting is disabled.

openQuestions.question: Is an SAP attachment API active for linking the invoice PDF?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Attaching the image is a manual step today.

openQuestions.question: Can a ServiceNow request to Vendor Master Data be raised through an API?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: The bank detail hold raises a ticket by hand today.

openQuestions.question: How should the GL account be chosen for a non-PO invoice from a vendor with no posting history?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: There is no rule today; it is a judgment point.

openQuestions.question: What turnaround should buyers meet when AP refers a variance?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Waiting on buyers is one of the largest delays and has no agreed time.

openQuestions.question: Where is the authoritative mapping of department heads for DoA approvals?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: It is kept in a personal Excel file; approvals cannot be routed reliably without it.

openQuestions.question: How are vendor credit notes processed?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Deferred to a separate session; the To-Be design must not ignore them.
